service.description: For a write of the current client contact on a record: whether the user is a client (else an error), whether it sees the record (get#ClientRecordVisibility; else "not available"), the record's project, and the record's internal people to write to (recipientPartyIds): for a work item its current assignees and managers, for a request its current assignee, each one only when internal, and always the project's internal managers (ProjectManager, Manager); when none of those, every internal person on the project. Internal: a person with a current role on the project that is not a client role (Customer, CustomerBillTo, ClientManager, ClientBilling), who is not on the client's side (its own or its organization's contacts) and has no user with PROJECT_CLIENT. internalPartyIds is every internal person of the project. Strict: anything that fails is an error.

parameter.name: checkOnly
parameter.description: Answer without an error (record null when the client may not write here), so a read's transaction is not marked rollback-only

service.description: What the current client contact may write on a record it sees, for the screens to show only those controls: canMessage (Send message and Reply in Chatter: a work effort or request of its client projects with someone on the team to write to), canUpload (files on a request it sees that is open), canCancel (an open request it raised). All false for a user who is not a client, or for a record it does not see. Never an error.

A client contact's Home (design-projects.md §3: Clients get Open requests, Waiting for your reply, Milestones in 30 days and Invoices due; their projects with the latest update posted for them; Recent replies on my requests; Waiting for your approval): every read under the client's own entity filters (BOSS_PROJECT_CLIENT, which the Projects root sets up), and the records named checked again by get#ClientRecordVisibility. Each part stands alone: one that fails is logged, left empty and named in failedParts. Empty for a user who is not a client.

Send message from a client contact in Chatter: a Message from the client's party to the record's internal people (get#ClientWriteContext recipientPartyIds; the client picks no one, so no other client and no outside party is reached), filed on the record (link#CommunicationEventRecord, which tells the record's followers of messages; a follower who is a client is told only of a message for it, filter#ClientAudience). No @ mentions: the body's mention marks are not notified.

Reply from a client contact in Chatter to a message on the record that is for it (a Message, or a status update posted for the client: get#ClientRecordVisibility), in the message's thread: a Message to the parent's people who are the record's internal people (its sender, its to and cc), else the record's internal people (get#ClientWriteContext), filed on the record. Never to another client or an outside party.

return.message: Message ${parentCommEventId} is not on this record

service.description: The link a client's message notices carry: a page of Projects (/qapps/Projects/...), else none.

actions.script: const text = String(recordUrl || '').trim() recordUrl = /^\/q?apps\/Projects\/[A-Za-z0-9_\/]+(\?[A-Za-z0-9_=&%.\-]*)?$/.test(text) ? text : null

service.description: The files a client contact may add to a request (as the public request form takes them): at most 5, each at most 10 MB, of the kinds a request holds (pictures, PDF, text, office documents and archives; never html, svg or scripts), their names cleaned. An error names the first file refused.
Internal to this file, after the checks: the files as RequestContent of the request (each on its own: one that cannot be kept is logged and named in failedList). Called with authorization disabled.

New request by a client contact (design-projects.md §6: clients raise requests in their projects): a Submitted request in one of its client projects (get#ClientProjectInfo clientProjectIds), filed by the client (Reporter), its organization the Customer, of a type the project offers (get#IntakeSettings; its default when not given), with the project's triage assignee; the files as the public form takes them (check#ClientFiles). The triage notice is Mantle's (the Request rule on a Submitted request).

Files a client contact adds to a request it sees (get#ClientRecordVisibility) while the request is open, as the public form takes them (check#ClientFiles); each file on its own. The answer is RecordFiles' upload's.

return.message: Choose one or more files to add

service.description: A client contact cancels a request it raised (filed by its party) while the request is open; the team is told by the request's status notices.

return.message: Only a request you raised can be cancelled here
CASE_IN_CUSTOMER_SERVICE: Request ${requestId} is a support case: the team closes it

service.description: A client contact's decision on a milestone gate (design-projects.md §4 MilestoneGate: "a client contact always here"): approve, or refuse with the reason, the waiting approval of a milestone of its client project whose approver is the client's own party (mantle.work.ProjectServices get#MilestoneApprovalAccess isApprover, canView; then approve#MilestoneApproval or refuse#MilestoneApproval, which check it again and record it as the approver's own). The project's Estimate milestone is the estimate's approval: approving it moves the project and its orders on.
